Aurora.combo: You can stun Aurora by positioning minions on one side and her on the other, then using Sett E Facebreaker. When engaging with Sett R The Show Stopper, throw her toward your team, then chain Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down attacks at the landing point.
Aurora.laning: Before Sett R The Show Stopper is available, don’t force your way toward ranged Aurora. Pull the wave toward your tower to farm, and look for an angle to catch her with Sett E Facebreaker when your jungler arrives. If Aurora Q Twofold Hex is on you and your health falls below half, retreat before the return damage hits.
Aurora.escape: Don’t engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down; check Aurora E The Weirding and R Between Worlds too. If Aurora E The Weirding and W Across the Veil are both down and R Between Worlds hasn’t come off cooldown, close the distance with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch her with Sett E Facebreaker.
Aurora.teamfight: Build Grit as you join a fight that’s already underway, and in a narrow passage use Sett E Facebreaker to group enemies before hitting them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If Aurora dashes in with W Across the Veil and no one is killed, that’s an opportunity to catch her. If an ally is killed, Aurora W Across the Veil’s cooldown resets, so don’t leave a low-health ally behind as you retreat.
Aurora.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots in the early game. After completing one core item, build a magic resistance item to counter Aurora’s main magic damage. If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s healing is enough to turn trades around, fit in Executioner's Calling.
Aurora.fight: Don’t try to walk up to Aurora and engage first. Look for an opening when Aurora E The Weirding and W Across the Veil are down. If taking damage has built your Grit, use Sett W Haymaker right after taking damage to gain a shield and retaliate. When you get close, use both Sett Q Knuckle Down empowered attacks on Aurora.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, it’s difficult to get onto a ranged formation, so choose your angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when the curse returns, and the return damage increases the more health Sett has lost. If cursed, move off the straight line between Aurora and yourself; if your health is low, retreat before the curse returns. After Aurora R Between Worlds appears, you’ll be slowed when leaving it, so decide whether to leave before the area appears or fight inside it.

Chogath.phase: Sett is strong in the mid game as health items stack up. Cho'Gath gets stronger as he stacks, making him harder to face over time, so pressure him early and don’t give up kills.
Chogath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots in the early game. After completing one core item, build a magic resistance item against the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. If Cho'Gath P Carnivore’s healing is enough to turn trades around, fit in Executioner's Calling.
Chogath.combo: After dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture or waiting for the silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to end, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when you’re in attack range and land both empowered attacks. Then pull Cho'Gath forward with Sett E Facebreaker and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker to hit him.
Chogath.escape: An opening to engage comes when Cho'Gath Q Rupture is used on the wave or immediately after you see its warning and dodge it. Cho'Gath has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have an angle, close the distance with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker at the landing point. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, don’t press an engage ability; walk away.
Chogath.fight: Let Cho'Gath use an ability first, dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture sideways, then retaliate when the damage you’ve taken has filled Sett W Haymaker’s Grit. As soon as you’re close enough to attack, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and land both empowered attacks on the champion. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream has silenced you, walk out of its area first, then chain your abilities.
Chogath.laning: Change your position so you aren’t also hit by Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes while standing in a straight line behind minions. Push or pressure the lane from early on to limit Cho'Gath’s time to scale, but if your health is in a precarious state, stay out of range where Cho'Gath R Feast can kill you.
Chogath.teamfight: Join a fight that’s underway and take damage to build Grit for Sett W Haymaker. In a narrow passage, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you grab Cho'Gath, who builds health, and if you have an angle to move an enemy key damage dealer toward your team, use it to break up their formation.
Chogath.watch: When the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears beneath you, immediately walk sideways to dodge it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, don’t press any abilities; walk out of its area first. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces through minions, so move out of the line where he attacks, and if your health is at or below half, retreat out of range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to deal with Poppy’s main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about choosing to stack only health. Don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just to deal with Poppy.
Poppy.combo: If you’re close, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as you’re in basic attack range and use both empowered attacks on Poppy. Then pull her in with Sett E Facebreaker and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker after taking damage to build Grit. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, follow up from the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, then Sett Q Knuckle Down’s basic attacks.
Poppy.escape: Poppy E Heroic Charge is a mobility tool, so the moment after she uses it is your window to close the gap. After confirming that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, engage with Sett R The Show Stopper and grab her with Sett E Facebreaker.
Poppy.fight: Let Poppy use her abilities first, then retaliate after the damage you take builds Grit for Sett W Haymaker. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t dash in with Sett R The Show Stopper; wait for it to end or walk up to her. When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, look for an opportunity to close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper.
Poppy.laning: Stay in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t stun you against a wall. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to prevent her from getting the shield. To aim for a stun with Sett E Facebreaker, position minions and Poppy on either side of Sett.
Poppy.phase: Sett peaks in the mid game as you build health items, and late game it matters where you use Sett R The Show Stopper.
Poppy.teamfight: Join a fight that has already started and take damage to build Grit for Sett W Haymaker. In a narrow passage, use Sett E Facebreaker to group enemies, then hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you grab a frontliner with bonus health, but choose that angle if it lets you bring key damage dealers toward your team.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, immediately walk out of the remaining area to avoid the second hit. When Poppy starts charging R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of her path.

Akali.fight: Instead of engaging first, wait for Akali to come out of her shroud and attack. If the damage you’ve taken has filled your Grit, retaliate with two Sett Q Knuckle Down empowered attacks and Sett W Haymaker. Don’t chase far just because one of Akali’s several mobility tools is down.
Akali.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Akali’s main magic damage in the early game. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, then build a magic resistance item after completing one core item. Get health as well so you stay out of Akali R Perfect Execution’s execute range.
Akali.combo: When you get close, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down, land both empowered attacks on the champion, pull them in with Sett E Facebreaker, then use Sett W Haymaker. You can stun them by positioning minions on the opposite side and catching them together with Sett E Facebreaker. Use Sett W Haymaker right after taking damage and line up its center with Akali.
Akali.escape: Especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, close the distance with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker. Keep in mind that Akali can escape if she still has even one mobility tool available.
Akali.laning: You can heal and stay in lane even after losing health, but keep in mind that Akali R Perfect Execution’s second hit deals more damage.
Akali.phase: Sett is strong in the mid game as health items stack up. In the late game, where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Akali.teamfight: Join a fight that’s already underway and take damage to build Grit. In a narrow passage, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If you can throw the enemy’s key damage dealer toward your team with Sett R The Show Stopper, look for that angle.
Akali.watch: If you’re hit and marked, the second dash will follow you even if you run away.

Olaf.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that resistances can’t reduce, so build health as well. Since basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, options that reduce attack speed are also effective.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and land both empowered attacks. Then pull Olaf in with Sett E Facebreaker, and when the damage you’ve taken has built up Grit, hit him with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If you need to close the gap, engage with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow up with Sett E Facebreaker at the landing point.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window after Olaf R Ragnarok ends is Sett’s chance to engage. Deny him the chance to pick up Olaf Q Undertow’s axe and disrupt his approach path, then close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow up with Sett E Facebreaker.
Olaf.fight: Early on, let Olaf use his abilities rather than engaging first, then spend the Grit built from the damage you take on Sett W Haymaker. Activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when you’re in basic attack range to land both empowered attacks on Olaf. Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal as his health gets lower, so don’t recklessly chase just because he’s at half health.
Olaf.laning: Move opposite the direction Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands to prevent him from picking it up.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows and reduces armor, so move opposite the direction the axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so when your health is low, respond with the shield from Sett W Haymaker or with distance rather than armor. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t try to catch him with Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper; create distance instead. If Olaf keeps hitting you, Ragnarok’s duration is extended, so fight again after it ends.
Olaf.phase: Sett peaks in mid game as he builds health items, while Olaf becomes relatively weaker as the game goes on. In late game, it's hard for Sett to reach the enemy formation, so choose carefully where to use your one cast of Sett R The Show Stopper.
Olaf.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in first, join a fight already underway and build Grit from the damage you take as you engage. In a narrow passage, group several enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait it out, then catch him with Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper once it ends.

Tryndamere.phase: In the late game, it’s hard for Sett to reach a ranged formation, so where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters. The available information isn’t enough to determine how the matchup against Tryndamere changes over time.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Thornmail is also effective against an opponent who relies on basic attacks. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust is enough to turn trades around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build.
Tryndamere.combo: For a standard trade, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when you can land a basic attack, hit with both empowered attacks, then pull enemies together with Sett E Facebreaker and land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. When using Sett E Facebreaker, you can stun Tryndamere by keeping a minion on one side and Tryndamere on the other. If you engage after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, follow up with Sett R The Show Stopper → Sett E Facebreaker at the landing spot → Sett W Haymaker with Grit built up → Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t rush your damage; use crowd control to run out its duration.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after you make Tryndamere use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is Sett’s chance to engage. Close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker to prevent his escape. Right after you’re hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, don’t start a basic attack fight because your attack damage is reduced.
Tryndamere.fight: Let Tryndamere engage first, then build Grit for Sett W Haymaker with the damage you take before retaliating. If you start attacking with basic attacks, finish with Sett P Pit Grit’s right punch. Activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when you can land a basic attack and use both empowered attacks on the champion. When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance or control him and wait before dealing damage.
Tryndamere.laning: When you can safely harass, disrupting Tryndamere’s last hits reduces the Fury he builds, lowering both his critical strike threat and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. When Tryndamere starts attacking minions to build Fury, create distance before engaging.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Enter a fight already underway and take damage to build Grit. Then group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, use Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper to run out its duration, then deal damage after it ends. If Tryndamere is in a side lane and Sett R The Show Stopper is on cooldown, don’t go stop him alone; send more players or trade for an objective.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury’s critical strikes become threatening after he builds Fury by attacking minions, so create distance when you see him doing that. If you’re hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, avoid fighting with basic attacks; when backing off, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a dash, and its cooldown is reduced by critical strikes, so don’t chase him where there are many minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can’t die, so use Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper to run out the duration instead of unloading damage.

Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed and stuns with an empowered attack, so stay outside basic attack range and wait it out. When you see the indicator for Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. Don’t recklessly fight while Volibear has built stacks of P The Relentless Storm by attacking minions or while Volibear R Stormbringer is available.
Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul turns trades around, fit in Executioner’s Calling and keep its Grievous Wounds effect up with Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals magic damage based on your max health, so be careful about choosing items that only add health.
Volibear.combo: As soon as Volibear uses an ability and is in basic attack range, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and land both empowered attacks on him. Then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and use your stored Grit with Sett W Haymaker, hitting him with its centerline. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker → W Haymaker → Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks.
Volibear.escape: Don’t engage just because Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down; look for an opening before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back. Then close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow up with Sett E Facebreaker to limit his chance to escape. It’s an even better time to take a fight if Volibear P The Relentless Storm’s stacks are also down.
Volibear.fight: Let Volibear use his abilities first, then retaliate after taking damage to build Grit for Sett W Haymaker. Move to the side of Volibear E Sky Splitter’s indicator, and use Sett W Haymaker’s shield and centerline damage right after taking heavy damage. If Volibear W Frenzied Maul could let him heal and you can’t finish him, back off and wait out the cooldown.
Volibear.laning: Move to the side when you see the area of Volibear E Sky Splitter, and engage just after Volibear P The Relentless Storm’s stacks fall off. When using Sett E Facebreaker, position minions on one side and Volibear on the other to set up a stun.
Volibear.phase: Sett gets stronger in the mid game, when stacking health items increases the Grit he can store in Sett W Haymaker. In the late game, it’s hard for him to reach ranged formations, so where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear engages with stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm, don’t take the fight right away; look for an opening as the stacks fall off. Once a fight starts, take damage to build Grit as Sett, then group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker in narrow passages and hit them with the center of W Haymaker. If Volibear has R Stormbringer, keep your distance even under your turret, and use Sett R The Show Stopper in a direction that breaks up the enemy formation.

Aatrox.build: Build armor first to withstand Aatrox’s main damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If his healing turns trades around, fit in Executioner's Calling. Add armor penetration against Aatrox’s armor, and aim to hit the center line of Sett W Haymaker for true damage.
Aatrox.combo: As soon as you’re in attack range, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down, land both empowered attacks on the champion, then pull them in with Sett E Facebreaker. If the damage you’ve taken has filled your Grit, line up Sett W Haymaker’s center immediately after Sett E Facebreaker to deal true damage. To stun with Sett E Facebreaker, use it with minions on one side and Aatrox on the other.
Aatrox.escape: Aatrox E Umbral Dash is an opportunity to close the distance right after he uses it. Grab him with Sett R The Show Stopper, then chain Sett E Facebreaker and Sett W Haymaker at the landing point. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, prioritize leaving its area before it pulls you back in.
Aatrox.fight: Instead of engaging first, dodge the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, then retaliate once the damage you’ve taken has filled Sett W Haymaker’s Grit. Look for a trade right after Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance’s empowered attack is used on a minion. While Aatrox R World Ender is active, a duel can turn even if you have the same health, so let some time pass before engaging again.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, avoid giving up kills and collect CS while watching Aatrox’s attack animations to dodge. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, immediately leave its area instead of hesitating over which direction to take. Sett P Pit Grit’s health regeneration lets you stay in lane and endure even after taking damage.
Aatrox.phase: Sett peaks in the mid game as health items stack up. In the late game, where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Aatrox.teamfight: Join a fight that’s already underway to build Grit, then use Sett E Facebreaker to group enemies in a narrow passage and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you grab a frontliner with high bonus health. If you have an angle to throw a key damage dealer toward your team, use it to break up their formation.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and knocks you up, so when you see the cast animation, dodge outside the blade’s tip range or move inside it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, immediately walk out of its area so you aren’t pulled back in. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing is increased, so stop dueling and create distance.

Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. Armor doesn’t work against the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, while Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing is enough to turn trades around, fit in Executioner's Calling.
Camille.combo: After Camille engages and deals damage, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as you’re in attack range and land both empowered attacks. Then pull Camille in with Sett E Facebreaker and hit her with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. You can also stun her with Sett E Facebreaker by positioning minions on the opposite side.
Camille.escape: The clearest opening to engage is after both Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum are down. Especially before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up, close the distance with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker to limit her chance to escape. If only one is down, account for her being able to escape with the other mobility tool.
Camille.fight: Let Camille use an ability first, then retaliate after the damage you’ve taken builds Grit for Sett W Haymaker. Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield activates, and use Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks on the champion once the shield is gone.
Camille.laning: Stand between minions and away from walls, and avoid positions where Camille E Hookshot can pin you against a wall. It’s good to take lane control and deny her farm before Camille completes her first core item.
Camille.phase: Sett is strongest in the mid game as health items stack up, but Camille can quickly destroy towers in a side lane, so don’t leave the lane open. In the late game, it’s hard for Sett to get onto a ranged formation, so the target and direction of Sett R The Show Stopper matter.
Camille.teamfight: Join a fight that’s underway and take damage to build Grit for Sett W Haymaker. In a narrow passage, group several enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when used on a frontliner with a lot of health, but choose the angle to throw a key damage dealer toward your team if you can.
Camille.watch: Near walls, watch out for the long engage and stun from Camille E Hookshot, and stand away from walls. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages, don’t use a response ability; counterattack after the trapped area ends.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Also get health, accounting for Darius E Apprehend’s penetration and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If his healing is enough to turn trades around, fit in Executioner's Calling, and consider armor penetration for Sett’s physical damage against Darius’s armor.
Darius.combo: After Darius E Apprehend is down, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as you’re in attack range and land both empowered attacks on Darius. Then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and, once the damage you’ve taken has built Grit, hit him with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, chain Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down attacks at the landing point, in that order.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown.
Darius.fight: Don’t start a long trade first. Take a short fight after Darius E Apprehend misses or after Darius Q Decimate is used on a minion. Right after taking damage, use Sett W Haymaker to gain a shield and deal damage, hitting the center line for true damage. Back off before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up too much to break the stacks.
Darius.laning: When using Sett E Facebreaker, position minions on one side and Darius on the other to look for a stun.
Darius.phase: In the late game, it’s difficult to get onto a ranged formation, so choose your angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Darius.teamfight: Join a fight that’s already underway, build Grit from the damage you take, then use Sett W Haymaker. In a narrow passage, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Use Sett R The Show Stopper to grab a high-health frontliner and increase the damage, or throw a key damage dealer toward your team if you have the angle.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you’re likely to get hit by follow-up attacks, so wait outside its range and approach after it misses. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade or stay close to his body to reduce the damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage has accumulated many stacks, create distance and get out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first against Dr. Mundo’s main damage from E Blunt Force Trauma. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Q Infected Bonesaw, and W Heart Zapper healing make the duel drag on, fit in Executioner's Calling.
DrMundo.combo: Position Dr. Mundo and minions on opposite sides of Sett E Facebreaker to stun him and remove Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases first. Then grab and throw him with Sett R The Show Stopper, and at the landing point chain Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker once Grit is built, and Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage when you have an angle to catch him after removing his passive. Use the window when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down as an opportunity to force a dive or an objective.
DrMundo.fight: Let Dr. Mundo attack first, build Grit from the damage you take, then retaliate with Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks and Sett W Haymaker. While Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, grabbing him first with Sett R The Show Stopper causes the suppression to be ignored, so use Sett E Facebreaker to stun him and remove his passive before engaging.
DrMundo.laning: After trading, step on the canister Dr. Mundo dropped as you retreat to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Sett peaks in the mid game as health items stack up. In the late game, where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
DrMundo.teamfight: Join a fight that’s already underway to build Grit, then use Sett E Facebreaker to group enemies in a narrow passage and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you grab Dr. Mundo, who builds bonus health, but choose that engage if you have an angle to move an enemy key damage dealer toward your team.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target it reaches and deals damage based on current health, so stand behind minions especially when your health is high. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma empowers his basic attacks, and Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage grants healing and movement speed, so don’t chase Mundo for long while his R is active.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Armor can’t block the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge, and Fiora R Grand Challenge also deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If her healing turns trades around, fit in Executioner's Calling.
Fiora.combo: After Fiora W Riposte is down and Fiora approaches, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down, land both empowered attacks, pull her in with Sett E Facebreaker, then use Sett W Haymaker. Use Sett W Haymaker right after taking damage, lining up its center with the position where Sett E Facebreaker grouped her. When Fiora Q Lunge is also down, engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, then chain Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down attacks at the landing point.
Fiora.escape: Right after baiting Fiora Q Lunge is an opportunity to close the distance. If Fiora W Riposte is down too, engage with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker to limit her chance to escape.
Fiora.fight: Instead of engaging first, retaliate after Fiora approaches and deals damage, once you’ve built Grit for Sett W Haymaker. After baiting out Fiora W Riposte, use Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks on the champion twice, catch her with Sett E Facebreaker, and hit her with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Don’t chase recklessly after a short trade.
Fiora.laning: Stand opposite the side where the Vital appears, and use the moment Fiora dives toward it as an opportunity to retaliate. When using Sett E Facebreaker, position minions on one side and Fiora on the other to look for a stun. Even after losing health, you can use Sett P Pit Grit’s health regeneration to hold your ground in lane.
Fiora.phase: Sett is strong in the mid game as health items stack up, letting you store more Grit.
Fiora.teamfight: If hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, move against a wall so you don’t expose all four Vitals. Join a fight that’s already underway to build Grit, then in a narrow passage group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Look for an angle to move an enemy key damage dealer toward your team with Sett R The Show Stopper, but force Fiora W Riposte out first if it’s available.
Fiora.watch: Fiora Q Lunge is a dash toward the direction of a Vital, so stand opposite the Vital and retaliate when she approaches. If hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, move against a wall to block one side’s Vital.

Gangplank.build: Build armor first from the laning phase against the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage deal true damage that resistances can't mitigate, so build health too. If healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy can swing trades, fit in Executioner's Calling.
Gangplank.combo: For a trade, get close, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down, then use both empowered attacks, Sett E Facebreaker, and Sett W Haymaker once you have built Grit. You can stun Gangplank by positioning him and a minion on opposite sides of Sett E Facebreaker, then line up the center of Sett W Haymaker with where they are pulled. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, catch and throw him with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up with Sett E Facebreaker and Sett W Haymaker at the landing point.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance, so engage when a nearby Gangplank E Powder Keg is unprimed. Once Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker.
Gangplank.fight: Engage and trade just after Gangplank E Powder Keg has been placed, while it is still unprimed. Activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as your attacks can reach him and use both empowered attacks on Gangplank. If you have taken damage and built Grit, retaliate with Sett W Haymaker. Once Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, catch him with Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper.
Gangplank.laning: Back off if a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg is nearby, and destroy it yourself if you can do so from outside the blast radius. Even after losing health, you can stay in lane and hold out using the health regeneration from Sett P Pit Grit.
Gangplank.phase: Sett peaks in mid game as he stacks health items. In the late game, where you use Sett R The Show Stopper is important.
Gangplank.teamfight: Join a fight after it starts and build Grit by taking damage before using Sett W Haymaker. In a narrow choke, pull multiple enemies together with Sett E Facebreaker and line them up for the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Find an angle to throw an enemy toward your team with Sett R The Show Stopper, and check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used before starting an objective fight.
Gangplank.watch: Back off if Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, and don't enter an area where two barrels overlap. Immediately after taking heavy damage, use Sett W Haymaker to turn your Grit into a shield and counterattack.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice cannot be reduced by resistances, so build health too. If healing from Garen P Perseverance is enough to swing trades, fit in Executioner's Calling.
Garen.combo: After Garen Q Decisive Strike is down and Garen W Courage's brief shield and tenacity window has passed, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as you can reach him and land both empowered attacks on Garen. Then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and hit him with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Sett E Facebreaker only stuns if it catches targets on both sides, so look for a position with a minion on one side and Garen on the other.
Garen.escape: Garen has no ability to create distance, so the window to engage is after his empowered attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike has been used. Avoid engaging right after Garen W Courage is activated. Close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up with Sett E Facebreaker at the landing point.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly just after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is used on a minion or has been used. If you take damage from Garen E Judgment, convert your stored Grit into the shield and damage from Sett W Haymaker, but don't stay in the spin for long. If you see Garen activate Garen W Courage, delay Sett E Facebreaker and Sett R The Show Stopper by half a beat.
Garen.laning: After pushing the lane forward, create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
Garen.phase: Sett peaks in mid game as he stacks health items, so fight aggressively then. Garen gets stronger over time because stacks of Garen W Courage are permanent, so pressure him from the early game. In the late game, choose your angle carefully when using Sett R The Show Stopper.
Garen.teamfight: Join a fight after it starts, taking damage to build Grit as you go in. In a narrow choke, pull multiple enemies together with Sett E Facebreaker and line them up for the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when used on a frontliner stacked with health, but choose the angle that sends a key damage dealer into the middle of your team if that is more valuable.
Garen.watch: If Garen Q Decisive Strike is active, engaging first will get your retaliation stopped by the silence. Garen E Judgment deals more damage the longer you stay close, so move out of its spin range. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage based on your missing health, so stay out of range if your health drops below half.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar's main physical damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so armor or health alone won't block all of it. If Mega Gnar R GNAR!'s wall stun is a threat, consider tenacity first.
Gnar.combo: If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, catch and throw him with Sett R The Show Stopper, then use Sett E Facebreaker at the landing point. Follow with the center line of Sett W Haymaker once Grit has built up, then land both attacks empowered by Sett Q Knuckle Down on Gnar.
Gnar.escape: Your window to engage is right after Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch. Close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up with Sett E Facebreaker to limit Gnar's chance to escape. Create distance just after he transforms into Mega Gnar, then engage again just after he returns to Mini Gnar.
Gnar.fight: Don't force your way in while taking Mini Gnar's ranged poke. Once Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker. Use Sett W Haymaker right after taking damage, when Grit has built up, to gain both a shield and damage.
Gnar.laning: Before Sett R The Show Stopper is available, pull the wave toward your turret and farm. If your jungler comes, put an enemy minion on one side and Gnar on the other to set up a stun with Sett E Facebreaker. Right after Mega Gnar ends and he returns to Mini Gnar, look for a chance to engage during the time he can't transform again.
Gnar.phase: Sett is strong in mid game as he stacks health items. In the late game, it's hard for him to reach a ranged formation, so the angle for Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Gnar.teamfight: Watch out for positions with your back to a wall and for narrow terrain so you can avoid the wall stun from Gnar R GNAR!. Join a fight after it starts, build Grit, then group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If Gnar has just returned from Mega to Mini, use the time he can't transform again to start a fight with your team.
Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit you on its return, so move out of its path. If Mega Gnar gets close, don't meet him head-on; create distance. Gnar R GNAR! stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don't stand with your back to one.

Gwen.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. After completing one core item, build into a magic resistance item. If Gwen's healing is enough to swing trades, fit in Executioner's Calling. Against high armor, use penetration or the center line's true damage from Sett W Haymaker.
Gwen.combo: Get close, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as your attacks can reach her, land both empowered attacks on the champion, then pull her in with Sett E Facebreaker and hit the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If you've just taken heavy damage from Gwen, use Sett W Haymaker with full Grit to gain both a shield and damage. When engaging with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, then Sett Q Knuckle Down's empowered attacks.
Gwen.escape: Your window to engage is right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used. Close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, then use Sett E Facebreaker to keep Gwen from escaping. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can come back quickly around a lot of minions, so it's better to pull her into an area without minions.
Gwen.fight: Let Gwen use her abilities first, build Grit by taking damage, then retaliate with Sett Q Knuckle Down's empowered attacks and Sett W Haymaker. Sidestep the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and use Sett W Haymaker immediately after taking heavy damage when Grit has built up. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch her with Sett E Facebreaker.
Gwen.laning: Stay outside her basic attack range so Gwen can't hit you with basic attacks. When health has decreased, you can stay in lane and hold out using the health regeneration from Sett P Pit Grit.
Gwen.phase: Sett peaks in mid game as he stacks health items, but also build magic resistance to account for Gwen's damage based on your maximum health. In the late game, it's hard to reach a ranged formation, so choose your angle carefully when using Sett R The Show Stopper.
Gwen.teamfight: Join a fight after it starts and build Grit. In a narrow choke, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you catch a frontliner who has built health. If you have an angle to send a key damage dealer into the middle of your team, throwing them there is also a good choice.
Gwen.watch: Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s center deals true damage, so sidestep when she casts it. Hitting minions with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash greatly reduces its cooldown, so don't chase her recklessly through the wave. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can't target her from outside the mist, so go inside or wait for it to end.

Illaoi.build: Build armor first because Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deal most of her damage as physical damage. If Illaoi's healing can swing trades, fit in Executioner's Calling. Given the damage based on maximum health from Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, avoid greatly increasing health alone.
Illaoi.combo: Close the gap just after Illaoi uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when your attacks can reach her and land both empowered attacks on the champion. Then pull her in with Sett E Facebreaker and, once you've built Grit from the damage you took, line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. You can also stun her by positioning a minion on one side of Sett and Illaoi on the other before using Sett E Facebreaker.
Illaoi.escape: Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is a mobility tool, so your window to engage is right after you bait her into using it. Close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up with Sett E Facebreaker. You can also engage after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit.
Illaoi.fight: Rather than engaging first, dodge or absorb Illaoi's abilities and then retaliate. Use Sett W Haymaker right after taking damage to turn your stored Grit into a shield and damage, and aim the center line at Illaoi. If Illaoi uses Illaoi R Leap of Faith, create distance for its duration.
Illaoi.laning: Don't fight where tentacles are placed near walls, and keep the lane away from walls. Farm from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit's range, and destroy tentacles if you can. If you can fight after your spirit is pulled out, retaliate; when you choose not to fight, break the tether and dodge the first tentacle.
Illaoi.phase: Sett peaks in mid game as he stacks health items, but don't fight in areas covered by Illaoi's tentacles. In the late game, where you use Sett R The Show Stopper is important.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don't fight near Illaoi's tentacles. If you don't have time to destroy them, pull her into open ground away from walls. If Illaoi uses Illaoi R Leap of Faith, spread out and give her no target to hit until it ends. After a fight starts, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit pulls out your spirit and marks you, so farm from outside its range and dodge it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith is her highest damage window and spawns a tentacle for each champion it hits, so don't group up in front of Illaoi, and spread out if she uses it.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Basic attacks and attack speed are also key parts of Irelia's damage, so reducing her attack speed is effective. If healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge is enough to swing trades, fit in Executioner's Calling.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia engages and your attacks can reach her, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and land both empowered attacks on the champion. Then pull her in with Sett E Facebreaker and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. To stun Irelia with Sett E Facebreaker, catch her with a minion positioned on the opposite side of Sett.
Irelia.escape: Your window to engage is right after you bait Irelia into using Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Sett R The Show Stopper is available, close the gap then and catch her with Sett E Facebreaker after landing. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, there is one less crowd control ability to watch for as you engage.
Irelia.fight: Let Irelia engage first, then build Grit for Sett W Haymaker from the damage you take and retaliate. Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used, catch her with Sett E Facebreaker to limit her chance to escape. Use Sett W Haymaker right after taking damage to make the most of its shield and center line damage.
Irelia.phase: Sett peaks in mid game as he stacks health items. In the late game, where you use Sett R The Show Stopper is important.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a big impact in teamfights, so prioritize targeting Irelia. Join a fight after it starts and build Grit. In a narrow choke, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If you have an angle to move Irelia toward your team, catch and throw her with Sett R The Show Stopper.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the gap and heal, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you're trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to defend against the magic damage from Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike. After completing one core item, build into a magic resistance item, but Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, so one type of resistance won't block all of his damage. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about building a lot of health alone.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when your attacks can reach him and land both empowered attacks. Then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and hit him with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If Jax Q Leap Strike is down and you have an opening to engage, catch and throw him with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker → Sett W Haymaker → Sett Q Knuckle Down's empowered attacks.
Jax.escape: Don't engage while Jax E Counter Strike is active; wait outside its stun range for the duration to end. Your window to go in is right after Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is also down. Close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up with Sett E Facebreaker to keep him from escaping.
Jax.fight: Let Jax use his abilities first, then turn the Grit built from the damage you take into a shield and damage with Sett W Haymaker. Stop basic attacking and create distance while Jax E Counter Strike is active, then trade with Sett Q Knuckle Down's empowered attacks after it ends. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don't engage recklessly.
Jax.phase: Sett peaks in mid game as he stacks health items. In the late game, the angle for a single engage with Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don't group up around him. Avoid the area stun, then catch him with Sett E Facebreaker and Sett R The Show Stopper right after the stun ends. Sett should join a fight after it starts, building Grit as he goes in. In a narrow choke, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center line of Sett W Haymaker.
Jax.watch: Basic attacks are negated during Counter Strike, and the reactivation damage increases with each attack dodged. Watch out for Counter Strike to follow when Jax engages with Jax Q Leap Strike.

Jayce.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to counter Jayce's main damage, but remember that it will not block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deals damage based on your max health, so get movement speed to escape its telegraphed area instead of stacking only health.
Jayce.combo: When Jayce's leap is down and you have an opening to engage, catch him with Sett R The Show Stopper and throw him, then follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down empowered attacks, in that order. For a close trade, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as your basic attacks can reach, hit twice, then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Jayce.escape: The moment after Jayce uses the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is your window to engage. If the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate is also down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, then catch him with Sett E Facebreaker.
Jayce.fight: Early on, don't force your way in while taking ranged harass from Jayce. After the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and pin him with Sett E Facebreaker. Use Sett W Haymaker right after taking damage to turn your stored Grit into a shield and damage.
Jayce.laning: Avoid forced trades before Sett R The Show Stopper is unlocked, and pull the wave toward your turret to farm. Dodge the linear poke from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast side to side, and if health has dropped significantly, clear the wave and return. When your jungler comes, follow up with Sett E Facebreaker; once Sett R The Show Stopper is unlocked, use it together with Sett E Facebreaker to catch Jayce.
Jayce.phase: Sett peaks in mid game as he builds health items. In late game, it's hard for him to reach the ranged formation, so choose your angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Jayce.teamfight: Join a fight already underway to build Grit, then stick to Jayce once the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down. In a narrow passage, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. If you have an angle to throw an enemy's main damage dealer toward your team with Sett R The Show Stopper, look for that engage.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce is holding his cannon and uses Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate, he can follow with Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, so sidestep out of the line. When he is holding his hammer, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate.

Kayle.build: Early on, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. After completing one core item, build magic resistance to counter Kayle's primary magic damage. If the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing is enough to turn a trade around, fit in Executioner's Calling.
Kayle.combo: Once you're close, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down, hit Kayle twice with empowered attacks, then pull her in with Sett E Facebreaker. You can stun her with Sett E Facebreaker by positioning Kayle and a minion on either side of Sett. When damage has built your Grit, line up the center of Sett W Haymaker on Kayle.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no innate mobility, so when you get an opening to reach her, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker. Engage from a position where Sett E Facebreaker can stun her, so she can't escape with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If Kayle has already used Kayle R Divine Judgment, start the fight without waiting for the invulnerability.
Kayle.fight: Activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when your basic attacks can reach or when you start chasing, and use Sett W Haymaker right after damage from Kayle builds your Grit. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is still available, lock her down with Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper, then deal damage after the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a route to reach Kayle from the flank or outside her vision, and coordinate your engage timing with your team's crowd control. When Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, lock her down with Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper to wait out the invulnerability, then attack. After Sett takes damage and builds Grit, use Sett W Haymaker, but don't walk straight in and take Kayle's attacks for too long.
Kayle.watch: Avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces resistances. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on your missing health, so be especially careful when your health is low. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don't dump your damage; lock her down with Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper to run out the invulnerability.

Kled.build: Build armor first against Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting, his main sources of damage. Armor won't block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal max-health-based damage, so be careful about stacking only health. If crowd control is getting you killed, you can prioritize tenacity; lowering his attack speed can also buy time before Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth basic attack.
Kled.combo: After Kled engages and deals damage, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and hit twice with empowered attacks, then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. Use Sett W Haymaker right after the damage you've taken builds your Grit for a stronger shield and more damage. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down basic attacks, in that order.
Kled.escape: Don't engage just because Kled E Jousting is down. Look for a chance before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, first look for a chance to create distance before it pulls you in.
Kled.fight: Let Kled use his abilities first, then use the Grit you've built from taking damage to answer with Sett W Haymaker's shield and damage. If Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, don't fight through all four basic attacks; disengage, then re-engage. When you go in, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down, hit Kled twice with empowered attacks, catch him with Sett E Facebreaker, and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Kled.laning: When Kled dismounts from Skaarl, check his Courage meter and create distance to prevent him from remounting if you can't reliably finish him off. After dismounting him, push him out of lane so he can't build Courage by killing minions.
Kled.phase: Sett gains more ways to use Grit as his health grows in mid game, while Kled weakens after laning and mid game, so it's advantageous to avoid giving him an early lead. In late game, it's hard for Sett to reach the ranged formation, so where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Kled.teamfight: Use vision on the flanks to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s approach, and if you can't stop it, keep a formation where your frontline takes the first charge. Once a fight starts, build Grit from the damage you take as you engage; in a narrow area, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you catch a health-stacking frontliner, and if you get an angle to carry a main damage dealer toward your team, you can aim to break their formation that way.
Kled.watch: Kled W Violent Tendencies deals a burst of max-health-based damage on his fourth basic attack, so if it's active, create distance before taking all four hits. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before it pulls you in. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can engage from far away, so check the flanks with vision in advance.

Malphite.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Malphite's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, then build a magic resistance item after completing one core item. Since Malphite has high armor, make use of the max-health-based damage from Sett Q Knuckle Down and the true damage along the center of Sett W Haymaker when attacking.
Malphite.combo: If Malphite E Ground Slam is down and you've broken Malphite P Granite Shield, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as you engage and hit the champion twice with empowered attacks. Follow with Sett E Facebreaker to pull him in, then, when the damage you've taken has built your Grit, line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, after throwing him, follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down basic attacks, in that order.
Malphite.escape: At that point, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow up with Sett E Facebreaker. Don't start a trade right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then engage when Malphite E Ground Slam is down. When Malphite's damage has just built your Grit, use Sett W Haymaker to gain both a shield and damage. While Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker.
Malphite.laning: Break Malphite P Granite Shield and deal damage to his actual health, and don't stay within range of Malphite Q Seismic Shard for long.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn't knock up several of you, and counterattack right after the ability is down. Once a fight starts, build Grit from the damage you take as you engage; in a narrow passage, group several enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you catch a frontliner with lots of bonus health, but if you have an angle to throw a main damage dealer toward your team, choose that engage.
Malphite.watch: Being hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it hard to engage or disengage, so don't start a trade right after getting hit. Being hit by Malphite E Ground Slam reduces Sett's basic attack damage output, so engage after the ability is down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't be stopped by crowd control, so watch walls and bushes when you don't know where he is, and spread out from your allies.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus's main damage source, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. If the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands is a concern, buy a Null-Magic Mantle early for Sett's low magic resistance, then build a magic resistance item after completing one core item. Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on max health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Nasus.combo: When you're close enough for basic attacks to reach, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down, hit the champion twice with empowered attacks, then follow with Sett E Facebreaker and Sett W Haymaker, in that order. Position Nasus and a minion on either side of Sett E Facebreaker to stun them, making it easy to line up the center of Sett W Haymaker right after pulling them in. When engaging from far away, catch and throw him with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and empowered attacks from Sett Q Knuckle Down.
Nasus.escape: A good window to engage is when Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands has ended. Nasus has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you get an opening, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker. However, Nasus still has Flash as an escape.
Nasus.fight: Right after Nasus attacks you, use the Grit you've built to strengthen Sett W Haymaker's shield and damage and hit back. If Nasus W Wither is still available or Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don't force a continued basic attack trade.
Nasus.laning: Don't push the lane all the way to Nasus's turret; let it come toward you to limit the space where he can stack last hits with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Nasus has no escape tool other than Flash, so this position is good for calling your jungler to gank.
Nasus.phase: In mid game, make use of Sett's strength by building health items that let him store more Grit. As time goes on, Nasus becomes harder to fight as stacks of Nasus Q Siphoning Strike build up, and in late game where Sett uses his one cast of Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Nasus.teamfight: While Nasus has Nasus R Fury of the Sands active, keep your distance instead of taking him head-on unless you have a clear advantage. Once a fight starts, build Grit as you engage; in a narrow passage, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. Use Sett R The Show Stopper at an angle that disrupts the enemy formation.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, so don't continue trading basic attacks while affected. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting and wait out its duration unless you have a clear numbers and damage advantage. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor, so don't stay in the area.

Ornn.build: Given the maximum-health damage from Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn’s crowd-control combo, you can prioritize tenacity over resistances. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while W Bellows Breath and R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance.
Ornn.combo: When you’re in basic attack range of Ornn, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and hit him with both empowered attacks, then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker. If Ornn’s damage has built up your Grit, line up the center of Sett W Haymaker immediately after Sett E Facebreaker to aim for true damage. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up from the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker → Sett W Haymaker → Sett Q Knuckle Down’s basic attacks.
Ornn.escape: Don’t engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down; check whether Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available. In particular, before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker to keep him from escaping.
Ornn.fight: Let Ornn use his abilities first, then retaliate after the damage you take builds Grit for Sett W Haymaker. Dodge Ornn E Searing Charge, and when Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and grab him with Sett E Facebreaker. If you cast Sett E Facebreaker with a minion on the opposite side of Sett from Ornn, you can also aim for a stun.
Ornn.laning: If Ornn tries to forge an item in lane, stick to him and attack to interrupt the process. Get ahead while Ornn’s early damage is low, and pressure him before his items and your allies’ Masterwork upgrades stack up.
Ornn.phase: The mid game, as you build health items, is Sett’s peak, so extend your lead then. Late game, Sett has trouble reaching ranged formations, making each use of Sett R The Show Stopper important. Pressure Ornn to end the game before his items and your allies’ Masterwork upgrades stack up.
Ornn.teamfight: Avoid the line between the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn, then join the fight after it starts and take damage to build Grit for Sett W Haymaker. In a narrow passage, use Sett E Facebreaker to group multiple enemies, then hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you grab a frontliner with bonus health, but choose that engage if you get an angle to bring key damage dealers into the middle of your team.
Ornn.watch: The pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture also becomes terrain that knocks you up when hit by Ornn E Searing Charge, so move away from walls and pillars toward open space. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance until it wears off to avoid the extra damage and long crowd control. Ornn R Call of the Forge God can be recast even after you dodge the spirit the first time, so move out of the line between the spirit and Ornn.

Pantheon.build: Since most of Pantheon’s damage is physical, build armor first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, and Pantheon R Grand Starfall has armor penetration, so avoid stacking only health or only armor. Add penetration to your damage to deal with Pantheon’s high armor, and use the true damage along the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Pantheon.combo: If Pantheon’s attacks have built up your Grit, use Sett Q Knuckle Down’s two empowered attacks, Sett E Facebreaker, then Sett W Haymaker. Immediately after Sett E Facebreaker, line up the center of Sett W Haymaker where Pantheon has been pulled in. When you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up after landing with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, then Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks.
Pantheon.escape: Look for an opening when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and he can’t use it to stun or escape. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and grab him with Sett E Facebreaker. If only one of Pantheon’s mobility abilities is down, check before engaging, since he can escape with the other one.
Pantheon.fight: Let Pantheon use his abilities first, then retaliate after the damage you take builds Grit for Sett W Haymaker. When you’re in basic attack range, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down, use both empowered attacks on the champion, then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait to attack from the front or angle in from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions when Pantheon Q Comet Spear is poking you.
Pantheon.phase: Sett’s Grit becomes more effective in the mid game as you build health items, while Pantheon’s influence falls off late. In the late game, Sett has trouble reaching ranged formations, so choose the angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Pantheon.teamfight: Join a fight after it starts and take damage to build Grit. In a narrow passage, use Sett E Facebreaker to group multiple enemies, then hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you throw a frontliner with bonus health, but choose that angle if it lets you bring key damage dealers, including Pantheon, toward your team.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so be careful not to enter its range. Stand behind minions to reduce damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don’t attack from the front; wait for it to end or circle around to the side. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.

Quinn.build: Build armor first to deal with Quinn’s damage. Since the amount of Grit Sett can store for Sett W Haymaker increases with health, build health items afterward too.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and grab her at the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker. If you’ve built Grit from taking damage, hit Quinn with the center of Sett W Haymaker, then follow with both empowered attacks from Sett Q Knuckle Down.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is her escape tool, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to engage. Close in with Sett R The Show Stopper then follow with Sett E Facebreaker.
Quinn.fight: Start a fight when Quinn E Vault is down or when your jungler arrives. Use Sett W Haymaker as soon as the damage you take builds Grit, and if you get close, land both empowered attacks from Sett Q Knuckle Down on Quinn.
Quinn.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward your turret to protect your health while farming. Collect CS while Quinn P Harrier’s mark is absent, and don’t force your way into range.
Quinn.phase: Early on, Sett has fewer abilities available and Quinn outranges him, so protect your health and hold on. Late game, it’s hard to reach ranged opponents, so choose the angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn comes in from the side, grab her with Sett E Facebreaker. In a fight that has already started, build Grit and hit the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Quinn.watch: If you’re marked by Quinn P Harrier, move out of basic attack range and let the mark expire. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind a line of minions, and don’t force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available.

Renekton.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice. If the healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek is enough to turn trades around, work Executioner’s Calling into your build. Armor won’t stop the damage from Renekton R Dominus, and you can deal with the armor reduction from empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice by positioning to avoid the dash.
Renekton.combo: When you’re in basic attack range, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and hit the champion with both empowered attacks, then group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. Use Sett W Haymaker immediately after Renekton’s combo builds your Grit. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper after Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, follow up from the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, then Sett Q Knuckle Down’s basic attacks.
Renekton.escape: The moment after Renekton uses E Slice and Dice to disengage is your window to engage. Close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and grab him with Sett E Facebreaker. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down, counterattack after his first combo ends.
Renekton.fight: Look to trade when Renekton has no Fury. Let him use his abilities before you engage, then retaliate with the Grit you’ve built from taking damage by using Sett W Haymaker. If Renekton Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice are all down, counterattack with the empowered attacks from Sett Q Knuckle Down.
Renekton.laning: Don’t stand in or behind a minion wave and give Renekton E Slice and Dice a platform to engage from. If you avoid giving up kills and keep farming, the matchup improves from the mid game onward.
Renekton.phase: Sett is strong in the mid game as health items stack, while Renekton’s value falls after mid game. In the late game, choose the angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Renekton.teamfight: Join a fight that has already started and build Grit before using Sett W Haymaker. In a narrow passage, use Sett E Facebreaker to group multiple enemies, then hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. If Sett R The Show Stopper lets you throw an opponent toward your team, aim for an angle that breaks up their formation.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is around half full or higher, watch out for the empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Empowered W breaks the shield from Sett W Haymaker first, so don’t try to trade through his combo while his Fury is high and you’re in range.

Riven.build: Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build and get health as well to reduce the risk of being finished by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: After Riven engages and deals damage, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and land both empowered attacks. Then group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. When you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up from the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, then Sett Q Knuckle Down’s basic attacks.
Riven.escape: If only Riven Q Broken Wings is down, don’t engage right away; Riven can escape with E Valor or her remaining dash. Look for a window before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, and grab her with Sett E Facebreaker. If Riven W Ki Burst is also down, there’s less risk of being stunned during your counterattack.
Riven.fight: Let Riven engage first, then use Sett W Haymaker immediately after taking damage to gain a shield and deal damage in return. When Riven starts her combo, use Sett E Facebreaker to interrupt the remaining actions. After Riven Q Broken Wings is down, use both empowered attacks from Sett Q Knuckle Down on the champion.
Riven.laning: If Riven uses Q Broken Wings to clear minions, counterattack while both her main damage and escape tool are down. When using Sett E Facebreaker, position minions and Riven on either side of Sett to aim for a stun.
Riven.phase: Sett peaks in the mid game as health items stack, and late game you should choose the angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Riven.teamfight: When Riven engages and starts her combo, interrupt her follow-up attacks with Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper. Join a fight that has already started and take damage to build Grit. In a narrow passage, use Sett E Facebreaker to group enemies, then hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you grab a frontliner with more health, but if you have a good angle to bring key damage dealers toward your team, aim to break up their formation that way.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor let her dash in succession, so move backward to create distance when you see the first dash. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and its finishing damage increases with the amount of missing health, so keep your distance until its duration ends.

Rumble.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since most of Rumble’s damage is magic, keep building magic resistance even after completing a core item.
Rumble.combo: When trading at close range, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as you’re in basic attack range, use both empowered attacks on the champion, then follow with Sett E Facebreaker and Sett W Haymaker. Immediately after Sett E Facebreaker pulls Rumble in, line up the center of Sett W Haymaker. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up after landing with Sett E Facebreaker → Sett W Haymaker → Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so he’s easier to engage on after the movement speed boost and shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield are gone. If you engage after dodging both shots of Rumble E Electro Harpoon or waiting for Rumble to expend them, you reduce the risk of taking a heavy slow and magic resistance reduction. Once you’re close, use Sett R The Show Stopper to close the gap and grab him with Sett E Facebreaker.
Rumble.fight: Let Rumble approach first and use his abilities, then retaliate after the damage you take builds Grit for Sett W Haymaker. Don’t commit heavy damage while the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield remains.
Rumble.laning: If you’re hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, don’t stay there; create distance.
Rumble.phase: Sett peaks in the mid game as health items stack, but against Rumble, build magic resistance instead of stacking only health. Late game, it’s hard to reach the formation, so choose carefully where to use Sett R The Show Stopper.
Rumble.teamfight: Join a fight that has already started, turn the damage you take into Grit, then use Sett W Haymaker. In a narrow passage, use Sett E Facebreaker to group enemies, then hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. If Sett R The Show Stopper lets you throw an enemy’s key damage dealer toward your team, aim for that angle.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals magic damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay in the flames for long. If you’re hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, immediately create distance to dodge the second. If both shots hit in succession, the slow is stronger and your magic resistance is reduced.

Shen.build: Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choosing to stack only health. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t build only one type of resistance. Consider prioritizing tenacity to reduce the taunt duration of Shen E Shadow Dash over stacking more resistances.
Shen.combo: After Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when you’re in basic attack range and land both empowered attacks. Then pull Shen in front of Sett with Sett E Facebreaker and hit him with the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Shen.escape: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, that’s your window to engage while his mobility and taunt are down. In particular, if Shen R Stand United is also down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and grab him with Sett E Facebreaker.
Shen.fight: The moment after dodging Shen E Shadow Dash is your chance to counterattack. After taking Shen’s attacks, convert your built-up Grit into the shield and damage from Sett W Haymaker. Once Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends, hit the champion with both empowered attacks from Sett Q Knuckle Down.
Shen.laning: Push the lane to tie Shen up with CS and make it harder for him to affect another lane with Shen R Stand United. If Shen uses R Stand United and leaves the lane, alert your team and take an advantage in that lane.
Shen.phase: In the mid game, as you build health items, the amount of Grit you can store also increases, bringing Sett to his peak. Late game, it’s hard to reach ranged formations, so where you use your one cast of Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Shen.teamfight: Join a fight that has already started to build Grit, then use Sett E Facebreaker to group enemies in a narrow passage and hit the center of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you grab a frontliner with bonus health, but choose that angle if it lets you bring key damage dealers toward your team.
Shen.watch: If you’re taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll be hit by attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. Also move out of the path of the spirit blade returning to Shen to reduce how much Shen Q Twilight Assault is empowered. Don’t use basic attacks inside Shen W Spirit’s Refuge, since it negates Sett’s basic attacks.

Singed.build: Singed’s main damage is magic, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. After completing one core item, build into magic resistance.
Singed.combo: In close fights, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as you can land a basic attack, hit the champion with both empowered attacks, then use Sett E Facebreaker followed by Sett W Haymaker. Immediately after taking damage from Singed, when Grit has built up, land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. To engage, use Sett R The Show Stopper → Sett E Facebreaker at the landing spot → Sett W Haymaker → Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so don’t hesitate to catch him when you have an opening that avoids the threat of Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling. You can’t use movement abilities on the adhesive, so go around it, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper, and follow with Sett E Facebreaker.
Singed.fight: Let Singed use his abilities first, then use the damage you take to build Grit before retaliating with Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks and Sett W Haymaker.
