When you have an angle to engage that is clear of Singed W Mega Adhesive, catch him with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker.
Singed.phase: Force Singed to recall before he completes his core items, and make use of Sett’s midgame strength as he builds health items. In the late game, Sett has trouble reaching ranged formations, so choose the angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Singed.teamfight: Don’t chase Singed to the end. While he’s pinned by Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper, attack his allies. Enter after the fight starts, building Grit from damage you take. In narrow passages, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then land the center line of Sett W Haymaker.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase Singed when his health is low while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. Go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive. If Singed E Fling hits you there, it leads into a root, so watch where you’ll land if the enemy team is behind Singed.

Sion.build: Build armor first against Sion’s main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage, and Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor if it hits, so avoiding it matters too. Building a lot of health alone also increases the damage from Sion P Glory in Death, which scales with your maximum health.
Sion.combo: Activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when you can land a basic attack, hit Sion with both empowered attacks, then pull enemies together with Sett E Facebreaker and land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. You can also stun him with Sett E Facebreaker by keeping minions on one side of Sett and Sion on the other. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up at the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, then Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks.
Sion.escape: You can keep up the pressure after sidestepping Sion Q Decimating Smash’s charge. If Sett R The Show Stopper is available, close the gap during that opening and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker.
Sion.fight: Let Sion use Sion Q Decimating Smash first, then sidestep. If you take damage, retaliate with Sett W Haymaker using the Grit you’ve built.
Sion.laning: In melee, respond to Sion’s abilities instead of engaging first. After dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash, if you start with basic attacks, land Sett P Pit Grit’s right punch too, then back off. Sion’s maximum health keeps increasing when he kills units, so push the lane to disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.phase: Sett is strong in midgame as he builds health items, but Sion’s maximum health increases with every unit he kills, so don’t keep letting him farm. In the late game, Sett has trouble reaching ranged formations, making the direction of Sett R The Show Stopper important.
Sion.teamfight: Enter a fight already underway, building Grit from damage you take. In narrow passages, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Catching Sion, who has built bonus health, with Sett R The Show Stopper can increase its landing damage. After Sion goes down, reposition to avoid the attacks from Sion P Glory in Death.
Sion.watch: The longer Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, the more dangerous its knockup and stun become, so sidestep when you see him charging. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught charges in a straight line, so avoid facing it in narrow paths and dodge to the side. Even after you take Sion down, Sion P Glory in Death brings him back to attack quickly, so don’t keep fighting in place; reposition.

Skarner.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against the main damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Decide in advance whether to fit Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar into your build to prepare for the suppression from Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.combo: For a standard trade, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when you can land a basic attack, hit with both empowered attacks, then pull enemies together with Sett E Facebreaker and follow with Sett W Haymaker. Right after Sett E Facebreaker, line up the center of Sett W Haymaker on Skarner. When engaging after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, catch and throw him with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up at the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks, in that order.
Skarner.escape: The opening to engage is right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down. If you’re stunned by its wall collision, Skarner can use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact again soon, so account for his next dash and back off.
Skarner.fight: Let Skarner use his abilities first, then build Grit for Sett W Haymaker with the damage you take before retaliating. When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and keep him caught with Sett E Facebreaker.
Skarner.laning: Use Sett W Haymaker just after taking damage from Skarner, when Grit has built up, and make sure both of Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks hit the champion. When using Sett E Facebreaker, keep a minion and Skarner on opposite sides to try for a stun.
Skarner.phase: Sett is strong in midgame as he builds health items, but Skarner’s damage and durability both increase as he builds tank items, so delay that power spike. In the late game, Sett has trouble reaching ranged formations, so where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Skarner.teamfight: Enter a fight already underway and build Grit. In narrow passages, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, look for a chance to engage with Sett R The Show Stopper. Skarner R Impale ignores terrain and drags you along, so don’t stand right beside the edge of the dragon or Baron pit.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact dashes through terrain and stuns if he hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered attack is dangerous at close range, so keep your distance, and stay out of the short range of Skarner R Impale.

Teemo.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Teemo’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, then build into magic resistance after completing one core item.
Teemo.combo: To engage, catch and throw Teemo with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up at the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker and Sett W Haymaker. Line up the center of Sett W Haymaker on Teemo after pulling him in with Sett E Facebreaker. Use both empowered attacks from Sett Q Knuckle Down on Teemo when Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down or after the blind ends.
Teemo.escape: Engage right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down so Sett’s basic attacks aren’t negated. If Teemo has also used Teemo W Move Quick, that’s your chance to close the gap; catch him with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker.
Teemo.fight: Look to trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. If you’ve taken damage, use Sett W Haymaker before your built-up Grit starts to decrease to gain its shield and damage. Teemo can create distance with Teemo W Move Quick, so if you decide to engage, close in with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker.
Teemo.laning: Before Sett R The Show Stopper is available, don’t force your way toward ranged Teemo. Pull the wave toward your allied turret to farm, and look for a chance to pin him with Sett E Facebreaker when your jungler arrives. Don’t simply walk past a bush with no vision; handle it with a Control Ward or take another route.
Teemo.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to reach ranged formations, so choose the angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap from key paths, and watch areas in front of objectives and narrow passages. Enter after the fight starts, building Grit from damage Sett takes. Group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If you have an angle to throw a key damage dealer toward your team with Sett R The Show Stopper, look for that engage.
Teemo.watch: If you’re hit by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, even Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks are negated, so stop using basic attacks until the blind ends. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies poison damage even if you’re hit by just one basic attack, so stay out of range if you’re not ready to engage. Teemo R Noxious Trap is stealthed and applies a slow, so watch narrow passages and areas in front of objectives.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle’s basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp, and consider options that reduce his attack speed too. Trundle R Subjugate deals magic damage and steals resistances, so don’t try to counter it by stacking only resistances. If Trundle’s healing is enough to turn trades around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build.
Trundle.combo: For a standard trade, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down when you can land a basic attack, hit with both empowered attacks, then pull enemies together with Sett E Facebreaker and land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Keeping a minion and Trundle on opposite sides of Sett E Facebreaker lets you stun him and makes it easier to land Sett W Haymaker. When you have an opening to engage, catch and throw him with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up at the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks.
Trundle.escape: Engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you are outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker. If the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp is still active, wait for it to end before going in.
Trundle.fight: Let Trundle attack first, then build Grit for Sett W Haymaker with the damage you take before retaliating. Reengage when the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp has ended and you can fight outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. When you go in, use both empowered attacks from Sett Q Knuckle Down on the champion, and use Sett W Haymaker just after taking damage.
Trundle.laning: Trundle heals when nearby enemy units die, so don’t keep up long trades that only chip away at his health in front of a large wave. If you lower his health, secure an advantage immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.phase: Sett is strong in midgame as he builds health items, and in the late game where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Trundle.teamfight: In tight spaces, group multiple enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. Use Sett R The Show Stopper to grab a frontline champion stacked with health for increased damage, or, if you have the angle, to move a key damage dealer toward your team.
Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage, so avoid trading while its effect remains. Trundle’s attack speed and healing increase inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, so back out and let it expire. Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your escape route, so fight in open areas and immediately sidestep when a pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, Sett is at a disadvantage after losing resistances, so create distance.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s basic attack-focused damage, and reduce the damage you take by lowering his attack speed if you can. If the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm is a problem, Sett’s low magic resistance makes an early Null-Magic Mantle a good buy; then build a magic resistance item after completing one core item. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle turns trades around, fit in Executioner’s Calling.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr engages and deals damage, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as he’s in basic attack range and land both empowered attacks on him. You can stun him with Sett E Facebreaker by positioning minions on one side and Udyr on the other. Then line up the center of Sett W Haymaker on Udyr to turn your stored Grit into damage and a shield.
Udyr.escape: The moment after Udyr is made to use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is awakened, immobilizing effects have no effect, so catch him with Sett E Facebreaker after the awakening ends. If you’ve already been stunned by Udyr E Blazing Stampede, engage or disengage while he can’t stun you again.
Udyr.fight: Let Udyr engage and deal damage first, then use the Grit you’ve built up to strengthen Sett W Haymaker’s shield and damage before striking back. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, press the attack with Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks and give him no time to heal. If you’ve already taken one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you can fight back while that target can’t be stunned again.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so ward key routes and jungle entrances, and don’t push forward when you can’t see where he is.
Udyr.phase: Sett is strongest in the mid game, when stacking health items also increases how much Grit he can store. In the late game, it’s hard to reach ranged formations, so choose your target for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to take down Udyr first while he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield. Eliminate weaker enemies behind him, then use your numbers advantage to deal with him. Once a fight starts, take damage to build Grit as you engage. In narrow passages, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker, then hit them with the center of Sett W Haymaker. If you have an angle to throw an enemy’s main damage dealer toward your team with Sett R The Show Stopper, use it to break up their formation.
Udyr.watch: Watch for a stun right after Udyr activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your max health, so don’t fight him for long. While Udyr E Blazing Stampede is awakened, immobilizing effects have no effect, so use Sett E Facebreaker or Sett R The Show Stopper after it ends.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about building a lot of health alone. Urgot has fairly high armor, so add penetration to increase your damage and aim for true damage with the center line of Sett W Haymaker.
Urgot.combo: If Urgot E Disdain is down, catch and throw him with Sett R The Show Stopper, then follow up at the landing spot with Sett E Facebreaker, Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks, in that order. Right after grouping Urgot with Sett E Facebreaker, line up the center of Sett W Haymaker to land true damage.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only movement ability, so right after he uses it, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow with Sett E Facebreaker. Conversely, if Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits and makes it hard to escape, use Sett R The Show Stopper to get out.
Urgot.fight: Right after you make Urgot use Urgot E Disdain is Sett’s chance to close the gap. Use Sett W Haymaker just after Urgot damages you and your Grit builds up to gain both a shield and retaliatory damage. Staying near Urgot for too long lets his leg-cannon damage build up, so move beyond his range after a trade.
Urgot.laning: Before Sett R The Show Stopper is available, don’t force your way toward Urgot. Pull the wave toward your allied turret to farm, and pin him with Sett E Facebreaker and Sett R The Show Stopper when your jungler arrives. You can stun him with Sett E Facebreaker by keeping a minion on one side and Urgot on the other.
Urgot.phase: Sett peaks in midgame as he builds health items, and in the late game where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters.
Urgot.teamfight: Enter a fight already underway and build Grit from damage you take, then land the center line of Sett W Haymaker. In narrow passages, group multiple enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and attack with Sett W Haymaker. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so a frontline champion standing ahead can prevent it from catching allies behind them.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, and leg-cannon damage builds up the longer you stay near him, so move beyond his short range after a trade. If hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, you’ll be heavily slowed and targeted by shots from Urgot W Purge, so dodge the charge. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death has impaled you, get completely out of range before reaching the execution threshold.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath deal most of their damage as physical damage, so build armor first. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Health also increases the Grit Sett can store for Sett W Haymaker.
Yasuo.combo: As soon as Yasuo is on you, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and land both empowered attacks on him. Then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and hit him with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. You can stun Yasuo by positioning him on one side of Sett E Facebreaker and minions on the other.
Yasuo.escape: Look to engage right after Yasuo throws his whirlwind, when he has no way to knock you up for a while. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a short cooldown dash, so don’t chase just because he used it once. If Yasuo R Last Breath is down, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and follow up with Sett E Facebreaker.
Yasuo.fight: Let Yasuo engage and deal damage first, then use Sett W Haymaker to turn your stored Grit into a shield and damage as you strike back. Right after Yasuo’s whirlwind is down, follow him with Sett Q Knuckle Down, catch him with Sett E Facebreaker, and hit him with the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so a thin wave pushes toward your side, reducing the number of minions Yasuo can dash through with E Sweeping Blade to engage. Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first with light damage, then trade in earnest after its short duration ends.
Yasuo.phase: The mid game, when health items are stacking, is Sett’s peak, so look for opportunities when Yasuo’s whirlwind is down. In the late game, Sett has trouble reaching ranged formations, so choose the angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Yasuo.teamfight: In narrow passages, group several enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center of Sett W Haymaker. Sett R The Show Stopper deals more damage when you grab a health-stacking frontline champion, but if you have an angle to throw a main damage dealer toward your team, aim to break up their formation.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move to the side to dodge it as he approaches. After Yasuo hits Q twice, his next Q becomes a whirlwind that knocks you up, so watch and listen for its cues and dodge early. If you’re knocked airborne, Yasuo can follow up with Yasuo R Last Breath.

Yone.build: Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about heavily stacking health first. Prioritize movement speed to get out of its telegraphed attack range, and build resistances without focusing on just one type. Attack speed reduction also helps slow the cooldown of Yone Q Mortal Steel.
Yone.combo: For a basic trade, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as you’re on Yone and land two empowered attacks, then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and hit him with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If you keep Sett E Facebreaker available when Yone enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, you can stop his return. If you engage with Sett R The Show Stopper, follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker → Sett W Haymaker → Sett Q Knuckle Down’s basic attacks.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is down. Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are also ways for him to move, so look for an opening especially before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back. Then close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker.
Yone.fight: Let Yone engage first, then retaliate after taking damage to build Grit for Sett W Haymaker. As soon as he’s on you, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down and use both empowered attacks on Yone, then catch him with Sett E Facebreaker and hit him with the center of Sett W Haymaker. Use Sett W Haymaker right after taking heavy damage to make the most of its shield and damage.
Yone.laning: Keep your distance when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s whirlwind is ready, then pressure his health and CS by counterattacking after he uses an ability.
Yone.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to reach the enemy formation, so choose your engage angle for Sett R The Show Stopper carefully.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you don’t get hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave and give Yone a larger shield. Once a fight starts, take damage to build Grit as Sett and engage. In narrow passages, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center of Sett W Haymaker. Look for an angle to move enemies toward your team with Sett R The Show Stopper.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a whirlwind, stay out of range until the stacks disappear. After Yone enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, watch your remaining health because he can deal extra damage when he returns. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion hit, so don’t stand alone at the very back in a team fight.

Yorick.build: Build armor first against the damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage and damage based on your max health, so be careful about heavily stacking health alone. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is enough to turn trades around, fit in Executioner’s Calling.
Yorick.combo: If you engage after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, activate Sett Q Knuckle Down as soon as he’s in basic attack range and land both empowered attacks, then pull him in with Sett E Facebreaker and hit him with the center line of Sett W Haymaker. If you have an angle to get behind Yorick, grab him with Sett R The Show Stopper and throw him toward your team, then follow up at the landing point with Sett E Facebreaker and Sett W Haymaker.
Yorick.escape: The opening after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses is your chance to engage. If Yorick has also used Yorick W Dark Procession, close the gap with Sett R The Show Stopper and catch him with Sett E Facebreaker. Yorick has no mobility, so once he’s caught, he has no way to escape until he uses Flash.
Yorick.fight: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, then look for a chance to step forward and fight. Right after taking damage from Yorick, use your stored Grit to strengthen Sett W Haymaker’s shield and damage, and land both of Sett Q Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks on Yorick.
Yorick.laning: Don’t start a fight where Yorick has built up a lot of graves around him. Push the lane so Yorick can’t build graves while clearing minions on his side.
Yorick.phase: The mid game, when health items are stacking, is Sett’s peak, so pressure Yorick when you dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist. In the late game, where you use Sett R The Show Stopper matters, and if you can hold off Yorick’s split push and then join your team, you can trade it for an objective elsewhere.
Yorick.teamfight: Join a fight that’s already underway, take damage to build Grit, then use Sett W Haymaker. In narrow passages, group enemies with Sett E Facebreaker and hit them with the center of Sett W Haymaker. If you have an angle to throw an enemy’s main damage dealer toward your team with Sett R The Show Stopper, look for that engage.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you and deals damage based on your max health, so dodge the mist’s arc. If the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, move away from Yorick. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, you can break the wall by attacking it.
